name: Betty Simons
sources: Obituary of Carl Ray Simons, Fisher-Cheney Funeral Home, Troy, Aug 2025
notes: Wife of Raymond Elmer ("Elmer") Simons. Maiden name not recorded.
Carl Ray Simons's 2025 obituary names his mother as Wilma, not Betty; Elmer may have married twice, or Betty may be a nickname. Not resolved.
